negative_reviews.author: Jan Król
negative_reviews.text: Friend ordered vegi dumplings, got chicken instead, after waiting nearly 20 minutes for only that.

negative_reviews.author: Kuromi Sanrio
negative_reviews.text: The place was lovley, the food was amazing, however after finishing up we were ready to pay but couldn't get the attention of any staff, I don't want to say they were intentionally ignoring us as it was busy. After a while we managed to get the bill but then took another 10 mins trying to get a card machine.
